project_type: Full-stack web app with Cloudflare edge (TypeScript Worker), GCP Cloud Run backend (Python FastAPI), and Cloudflare Pages frontend
build_system: pnpm monorepo with wrangler for Cloudflare Workers, pip for Python backend, Docker for container builds
test_framework: vitest for edge worker tests, pytest for backend tests, playwright for frontend e2e
build_command: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit (edge), pytest apps/backend/ (backend)
verification_instructions: Run live HTTP tests against syrabit.ai, review configuration files for misconfigurations, produce audit report
setup_instructions: pnpm install for Node deps, pip install -r apps/backend/requirements.txt for Python deps
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access for live testing against syrabit.ai and api.syrabit.ai
contribution_requirements: Audit report should be a comprehensive markdown file documenting all findings
key_patterns: 9-pillar architecture: CF Workers (edge proxy/shield) -> GCP Cloud Run (FastAPI backend). Frontend on CF Pages at syrabit.ai. Edge worker at api.syrabit.ai handles JWT verification, Turnstile bot protection, rate limiting via KV, CORS, and proxies to backend. Backend uses Vertex AI Search for RAG, MongoDB Atlas, Upstash Redis, Sarvam AI for Assamese, Razorpay for payments.
directory_structure: apps/edge/ - Cloudflare Worker, apps/backend/ - FastAPI backend, apps/frontend/ - React frontend (CF Pages), infra/gcp/ - GCP infrastructure configs, .github/workflows/ - 25+ CI/CD workflows
